text: A masked assassin, hired by an unknown enemy, drops from the rafters at midnight.

outcomes.text: You overpower the assassin and learn who hired him.
The blade bites deep before you drive him off.
He weighs the coins and vanishes into the dark.

text: At a grand banquet you notice your host watching you a little too closely as you lift your cup.

outcomes.text: Nothing happens. Your host looks disappointed.
The wine is laced with poison.
You drain the cup. Your host's face falls as you do not.
You make an excuse and slip away.

text: A cracked mask lies half buried in a field, whispering promises in your sleep.

outcomes.text: A dark power floods into you. It feels better than it should.
The mask clamps down on your thoughts. You tear it off in agony.
It shatters with a scream. The whispers stop.

text: A demonic cultivator, wreathed in blood qi, blocks your path and demands tribute.

outcomes.text: You drive him off, and the villages are safer for it.
His strikes are vicious and hard to avoid.
He snorts and lets you pass.
You lose him in the woods.
He catches you at the river and takes what he likes.

text: A rickety ferry begins to sink in the middle of a wide river.

outcomes.text: You reach the bank, soaked and gasping.
The current drags at you cruelly.
You save three families before saving yourself.
You nearly drown helping, but the passengers live.
